text:
elaine: Posted updated company OKR draft for Q3 — need alignment on launch criteria + two tradeoffs: prioritizing Dedicated capacity ramp vs Hosted feature velocity, and the KMS/HSM gating timeline for Private deployments. Please read and sign off by EOD Wed. Link: https://redwood/share/okr-q3-draft

sam: skimmed. main ask: what exact SLO numbers do we need for Dedicated before we mark "GA" in the OKR?

mason: from infra POV we can hit 99.5% p99 latency for 8k token median if we reserve X GPUs + pre-warm. costs are ~ +12% infra. need commitment window to plan capacity.

elaine: proposal in doc: Dedicated GA criteria = p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms, p99 <= 650ms under committed throughput (50 sustained rps). Also require runbook + 2 incident drills.

lara: ops asks we add rollout criteria: canary at 5% traffic for 48h, automated rollback on error-rate spike >0.5% or latency regressions >20%.

ash: security flagged Private/KMS item: we need HSM integration + attestation + 3rd-party pen-test before we list Private as "Customer-ready" in OKR. That adds ~3–4 weeks.

elaine: understood. two options: (A) delay Private GA by 1 sprint and keep Dedicated on track, or (B) keep Private in the OKR but mark GA as "beta/controlled" requiring SOC sign-off and restrict to partner customers. Thoughts?

natalie: finance prefers option B — we can show revenue pipeline from early partners and not lose sales. But we need clear contract clauses about data residency and support SLAs.

jamie: high-level: we want revenue momentum without compromising security. I'm leaning B with a tight acceptance checklist.

sam: technical risk with B = maintaining two support paths (beta vs GA) is operationally heavier. We can do B if we cap partner count and require a partner onboarding checklist.

mason: agree. propose onboarding checklist snippet — include KMS integration, network policy review, runbook, perf baseline. paste:
```
onprod-verify:
  - kms-attestation: passed
  - perf-baseline: p95 <= 400ms
  - net-policy: 0 open inbound rules
  - runbook: pages and responders assigned
```

elaine: love it. we'll add that as "Private beta gating". decision request: Product + Eng + Security sign-off on checklist and timeline.

ash: security signs off on the checklist but still require pen-test before full GA. OK to list "beta" in company OKR. :white_check_mark:

natalie: finance approves B with two conditions: (1) partner cap of 5 customers in beta, (2) we capture expected ARR uplift in the OKR doc.

elaine: noted — will add partner cap and ARR estimates.

jamie: I'm good with option B. ask: can we commit to delivering Dedicated GA and Private beta by the end of Q3? if yes, I'll sign off.

sam: Dedicated GA — yes if infra commit confirmed today. Private beta — yes with the partner cap and pen-test gating for GA.

mason: infra commit confirmed. I'll allocate the reserved pool.

elaine: status: Dedicated GA criteria finalized; Private listed as "Beta" with checklist and partner cap. Action items:
- elaine: update OKR doc with checklist + partner cap + ARR numbers (today)
- mason: confirm reserved GPU pool and cost delta in doc (today)
- ash: schedule pen-test and add expected ETA (by end of week)
- natalie: prepare contract clause template for beta partners (Thu)
- sam: draft support/process notes for beta vs GA (Thu)

devex-bot: Reminder set — OKR sign-off meeting Thu 10:00am in #exec (calendar invite sent).

elaine: thanks all. If no objections by Thu 10:00am, I'll mark this as company OKR sign-off and publish. :thumbsup:

jamie: no objections from me. go ahead. :rocket:
